arabic text: JIBRIL NE NIDA YE DI (MAARE GAYE HUSSEIN)\nMAWLA PE KARBALA MEIN KHANJAR HE CHAL GAYAA
english translation text: Jibraeel gave the call: ‘Hussain has been martyred.’\nIn Karbala, the dagger was drawn across the Master’s throat.

arabic text:
HAY,HAY HUSSEIN AAPPAR KEYSA SITAM
HUWA
SHIMR-E-LAEENE MAARDIYA WA MUSIBATA
KARBOBALA KA FARSH BHI HAAN KAAMPNE LAGA
JIBRIL NE NIDA YE DI (MAARE GAYE HUSSEIN)
MAWLA PE KARBALA MEIN KHANJAR HE CHAL GAYAA
english translation text:
Alas, Hussain—what oppression befell you! The
accursed Shimr killed you: wa musibata. Even
the earth of Karbala began to
tremble. Jibraeel gave the call: ‘Hussain
has been martyred.’ In Karbala, the dagger
was drawn across the Master’s throat.

arabic text:
KHEIMEIN JALAYE SHIMR NE MARE TAMACHE BHI
KAANO SE SAKINA KE BAALI BHI CHIINLI
SAR SE RIDAYE ZAINABO KULSUM CHINGAYI
JIBRIL NE NIDA YE DI (MAARE GAYE HUSSEIN)
MAWLA PE KARBALA MEIN KHANJAR HE CHAL GAYAA
english translation text:
Shimr burned the tents and struck the children;
he tore Sakina’s earrings from her ears.
The veils of Zainab and Kulsum were snatched away.
Jibraeel gave the call: ‘Hussain has been martyred.’
In Karbala, the dagger was drawn across the Master’s throat.

arabic text:
SHAME GHARIBA AAGAYI TAARIKI CHAAGAYI
DEKHA JO BACHO MEIN TO SAKINA KAHIN NATHI
ZAINAB POKARI HAYE SAKINA KAHAAN GAYI
JIBRIL NE NIDA YE DI (MAARE GAYE HUSSEIN)
english translation text:
The night of desolation arrived and darkness spread;
when Zainab looked among the children, Sakina was nowhere to be found.
She cried, ‘Alas, where has Sakina gone?’
Jibraeel gave the call: ‘Hussain has been martyred.’

arabic text:
MAKTAL JO POHNCHI DOONDHTE DEKHA SAKINA KO
LASHE SE LIPAT KAR BEIN KARTI RAHI THI WOH
SINEPE APNE BABA SULAWO SAKINA KO
JIBRIL NE NIDA YE DI (MAARE GAYE HUSSEIN)
english translation text:
Searching, she reached the battlefield and saw Sakina
clinging to the body and continuing to lament.
‘Lay Sakina to rest upon her father’s chest.’
Jibraeel gave the call: ‘Hussain has been martyred.’

arabic text:
NEZA UTTHA YE ZAINAB PEHRE PE KHARI THI
ABBAS KO PUKAARKE HAYE NIDA YE DII
DEKHO TO KHUD YE ZAINAB ABBAS BANGAYI
JIBRIL NE NIDA YE DI (MAARE GAYE HUSSEIN)
english translation text:
A spear was raised while Zainab stood guard;
she called upon Abbas and gave this cry:
‘Look—today Zainab herself has become Abbas.’
Jibraeel gave the call: ‘Hussain has been martyred.’

arabic text: BABA KO DEKHA AATE TO ZAINAB TARAP GAYI
english translation text: When Zainab saw her father approaching, she was overcome with anguish.

arabic text: KEHTI RAHITHI HAAYE SADAYEEN YE DETI THI\nBABA AB AYE HO JAB ZAINAB HAY LUT GAYI\nJIBRIL NE NIDA YE DI (MAARE GAYE HUSSEIN)
english translation text: She kept crying out and calling:\n‘Father, you have come only now, when Zainab has been plundered.’\nJibraeel gave the call: ‘Hussain has been martyred.’

arabic text:
NAWHA YEH SHEH KA SUNKAR MAATAM KAREIN SABHI
MAWLA KI MUSIBAT PE GIRYA KAREIN SABHI
NAWHA SADA YE SHEH KA SUNAYEEGA YEH HABIB
JIBRIL NE NIDA YE DI (MAARE GAYE HUSSEIN)
english translation text:
Hearing this lament for the King, let everyone beat their chests;
let everyone weep over the Master’s suffering.
Habib will continue to recite this lament of the King:
Jibraeel gave the call: ‘Hussain has been martyred.’
